Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Seven newly developed items were drafted by the first author who used the themes noted throughout qualitative studies of positive body image (Frisén & Holmqvist, 2010; Wood-Barcalow et al., 2010) to guide item content. The 19 potential BAS-2 items (eight original, four revised, and seven newly developed) were reviewed by an independent researcher familiar with positive body image to (a) examine the extent to which the items comprehensively assessed body appreciation and (b) determine whether the wording of the items needed to be modified for clarity or style. This reviewer confirmed that the BAS-2 items were worded clearly and assessed the body appreciation construct comprehensively.

Number of studies.evidence_source: The section describes the development and review of items for the BAS-2, not a study involving data collection from participants.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the development and expert review of additional items for the BAS-2 instrument. It describes how new items were drafted based on themes from qualitative studies and then reviewed for comprehensiveness and clarity. The section also provides a rationale for the decision not to include negatively scored items in the scale.
